envelope.reason: the hook's reach exceeds the concept and can fail unrelated work

payload.title: line-worktree governs every Claude worktree on the host
payload.body: Ruled: (b), and pass creation through on every failure. The plan concept places a unit's worktree off its plan's line and says nothing about any other worktree. The hook acts only for the implementer's worktree in the repository whose plan is bound; for every other worktree, repository or failure (cratylus or jq missing, no plan bound, an unrecognized line) it leaves creation exactly as the harness would do it, never failing it.
